database:primary-key:user.decision: Every user id is a uuid. B's integer ids are re-keyed during import and kept in legacy_id until the import is checked (D03).

migration:user.decision: Approved: re-key B's users to uuid and rewrite B's foreign keys; dry run on a copy first. The example starts from an empty database, so no live data is touched.

api:contract:GET /api/users/{} response.decision: One user shape: {id: uuid, email, name, role, can_approve}. B's full_name maps to name (D05).

api:endpoint-auth:GET /api/users/{}.decision: Every endpoint uses the one cookie session (D02).

application:auth-provider:provider.decision: Team Hub runs its own accounts now (email and password). Google sign-in (M03) is deferred and will use the user's own Google OAuth app when picked up.

application:roles:roles.decision: Roles owner, admin, member plus an approve permission. A owner->owner, A member->member, B admin->admin, B requester->member, B approver->member with approve, C admin->admin, C member->member (D04).

application:route:/login.decision: One sign-in screen at /login for every user (the example ships the API; the UI is out of scope).

application:route:/settings.decision: One /settings screen with account and notification sections.

application:session:session.decision: http-only cookie sessions, 30 minutes idle, for every client (D02).

application:workflow:closing-tasks-with-.decision: Block moving a task to done while it has a pending approval. Implemented as a status guard the approvals module registers with tasks.

dependency:runtime:node.decision: Not applicable: Team Hub is built on Python 3.8+ with the standard library (D01); no source code is carried over.

dependency:version:react.decision: Not applicable: no React code is carried over (D01).

api:api-version:GET /api/users/{}.decision: One unversioned /api while there are no outside clients (D05).

api:duplicate-endpoint:GET /api/users/{}.decision: One GET /api/me for the signed-in user; user listing waits for an admin screen.

application:auth-methods:methods.decision: Password now; Google later with M03.

database:duplicate-entity:user.decision: One users table with the union of fields kept features use (D03).

application:component:button.decision: Not applicable to the API-only example; a UI would use one Button with primary, secondary, ghost and danger.

dependency:duplicate-library:date-librar.decision: Not applicable (D01): Python's datetime is used.
